notes.title: Bug Fix - v24
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that walled up non-host players at the beginning of the Defense match.

- Fixed a bug which ended on-going Defense match prematurely when waiting to respawn.

notes.title: Bug Fix - v23
notes.content:
- Fixed the issue that some of alphabet letters weren't visible on Character information screen.
- Fixed the issue that some words were not localized in Spanish.
- Fixed the bug which prevented users using a mouse pointer if the game was started with keyboard input.

notes.title: 4.0 Update
notes.content:
Hi, This is Janus Labs.

We would like to give you the encouragement to be healthy and safe from COVID-19  prior to notice about the update.

There is 4.0 update today.

The game can still be played by limited users like the backers.
The official release through the publisher is scheduled for sometime this year.

[Update Note]
1. DUO Mode : Now two players can stand on the same side and fight together. Try together to defeat your competitors and survive to the end.
2. Defense Mode (co-op Mode) : This mode protects the basecamp from incoming enemies with up to 4 players. Beware of the mighty boss troops appearing in every 10th wave!
3. Intro Video : It has been added to introduce the game background. 
4. Character Skin for the backers : You've been waiting a long time. Limited character skins for the crowdfunding backers have been unveiled. Please input your gift key to get the rewards.

notes.title: 3.0 Update
notes.content:
Hi, This is Janus Labs.
Happy New Year! 

This 3.0 update focuses on adding some rules, adjusting the difficulty, and improving performance. The game can only be played by limited users for the time being, and we'll let you know when it is ready to go.

[Update notes]
1) At the start of the battle, there are undead units that are stunted by bombing around the base. It's easier to make allies in the beginning.
2) Level-up during combat not only enhances the damage of the Alpha unit but also increases the health point of our allies.
3) Occupable or installable mechanical units, Octa Canon, Lycan, and Turret, will explode after a 100-second time limit.
4) Your game data is stored on the steam cloud server.
5) Fixed bugs and improved performance related to enemy and allies' movements.

We will try to make new content for the next update.
Please give us your feedback on the discussion board or send an email (lab.janus@gmail.com).
Thank you.
